description: Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment - The Collective Agreement between Associated Battery Manufactures (Ceylon) Ltd. No. 31, Attidiya Road, Ratmalana and other part Commercial and Industrial Workers Union Colombo 02 (E only)
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a Collective Agreement between a company and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory provisions about employment terms, working conditions, overtime, holidays, and disciplinary procedures. This falls under legal/regulatory matters as it involves the publication of a legally binding agreement under statutory authority (Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131).
